The six agent emissions of the 27 August run of record, transcribed verbatim from docs/CANDIDATE_MECHANISMS.md's table 'WHAT THE AGENT ARM ACTUALLY EMITTED'. It is a recording of what the clerk returned under the PRE-REPAIR prompt, kept so the intake path can be driven over the same input before and after.
